domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups of a PR in flight). Shape per ruling B on #33718 (record 6891082225): one checklist card per reviewed PR; later reviews of PR #33711 append here.

## review follow-ups of PR #33711 (card #33603)

Records: 6890932729 (first), 6891274033 (delta), the final delta on head `c48e9f19`. All items are nits, accepted for the landing; none changes a verdict the audit gives today.

- [x] N3 `SUB_AGENT_TOOLS` in `verify-review-tier.mjs` is an exact-name deny list: a skill that forks a sub-agent, or a connector tool that messages another thread, is not on it.
- [x] N5 a git-side read failing inside the arm (diff-tree status, changeset text, fork predicate) folds into `tier-h`, not `not-measured`; `armCell` prints only two reasons and can hide it.
- [x] N6 the audit's `baseRef` is the landed commit's first parent, where the queue used the merge group's base (fails toward BREACH).
- [x] N8 the approval leg reads review state as of now: an authorised approval dismissed after landing no longer clears (fails toward BREACH).
- [x] N9 the edited-after clause is appended only on the `absent` state; a dropped edited PASS beside an older FAIL or off-tier record is not named.
- [x] N10 `editedAfter` names any trusted comment edited after landing (claims, reports), not only records; "A, B was edited" wording.
- [x] N11 no audit battery row for `recognisers.available !== true` or a set without `trustedAuthors`; an untrusted PASS reads the same words as no record (the guard prints an ignored-authors line).

Resolved by PR #33762 (report 6892426950, at-tier PASS 6892490875): N3 N5 N8 N9 N10 N11 fixed with pin rows; N6 closed with its reason in readArmLanding's jsdoc (baseRef is read only through git merge-base by regenCarry). The review's own nits go to the card review follow-ups of PR #33762.

Carried elsewhere (not here): raw relay comment tier #33715; contract-review.md session evidence #33716; weekly audit owner #33717.

`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, `scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs`; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Waits for PR #33711.
